# BAD-088 — Correct the 'a spread would give info the pre-wrap phase' claim in collab/room.ts

## Brief
The comment at server/supabase/functions/collab/room.ts:19-21 says that handing loadRoom's collab back as a spread copy would give info the PRE-WRAP phase, with no type error to say so. That is not what would happen. Object.assign(collab, done) runs at room.ts:72, sixteen lines before the return at :88, so a spread taken on the return line copies the already-wrapped status: identity and spread give info the same phase. The property the comment defends (hand back the row by identity) is real and correct; the mechanism it gives for why is wrong. A reader who trusts it will guard against an edit that is harmless and will NOT guard against the edit that would actually break the wrap-on-read: a copy taken BEFORE the wrap block, or a refactor that makes the wrap write to something other than the object that is returned. The same sentence is repeated in the BAD-047 commit message (c6b41a9) and in the BAD-078 waiver fixture, so it has propagated three times; fixing the source comment is the fix.

Evidence: room.ts:37 const [collab] = await sql`select * from private.collabs where id = ${collabId}`; room.ts:72 if (done) Object.assign(collab, done); room.ts:88 return { collabId, collab, me, isHost, wrapDeadline, roomExpired };. Object.assign is the ONLY mutation of collab in the whole new tree (grep -rn 'Object.assign' over c6b41a9:server/supabase/functions/collab -> one hit, room.ts:72; old a0baf97:index.ts:672 is the same line). Semantics demonstrated with node: const a={status:'wrapping'}; Object.assign(a,{status:'wrapped'}); ({...a}).status === 'wrapped'. Readers: info.ts:47 status: roomExpired ? 'expired' : collab.status and info.ts:50 phase: collab.status. Repeats at: c6b41a9 commit message ('A spread would give info the pre-wrap phase and no type error would say so') and test/fixtures/movecheck/bad-047-collab.json, loadRoom-return group reason.
